SELECT "id", "subject", "customer_id", "requester_name", "status", "priority", "channel", "category", "assignee_id", "sla_due_at", "first_response_at", "resolved_at", "satisfaction_score", "description", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:tickets}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("subject"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("requester_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("description"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'subject' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "subject" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'subject' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "subject" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'requester_name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "requester_name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'requester_name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "requester_name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'sla_due_at' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "sla_due_at" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'sla_due_at' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "sla_due_at" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'first_response_at' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "first_response_at" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'first_response_at' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "first_response_at" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "subject", "customer_id", "requester_name", "status", "priority", "channel", "category", "assignee_id", "sla_due_at", "first_response_at", "resolved_at", "satisfaction_score", "description", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:tickets}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("subject"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("requester_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("description"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "subject", "customer_id", "requester_name", "status", "priority", "channel", "category", "assignee_id", "sla_due_at", "first_response_at", "resolved_at", "satisfaction_score", "description", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:tickets}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:tickets}} ("subject", "customer_id", "requester_name", "status", "priority", "channel", "category", "assignee_id", "sla_due_at", "first_response_at", "resolved_at", "satisfaction_score", "description", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::timestamptz, $10::timestamptz, $11::timestamptz, $12::int, $13::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "subject", "customer_id", "requester_name", "status", "priority", "channel", "category", "assignee_id", "sla_due_at", "first_response_at", "resolved_at", "satisfaction_score", "description", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:tickets}}
SET "subject" = $2::text, "customer_id" = $3::int, "requester_name" = $4::text, "status" = $5::text, "priority" = $6::text, "channel" = $7::text, "category" = $8::text, "assignee_id" = $9::int, "sla_due_at" = $10::timestamptz, "first_response_at" = $11::timestamptz, "resolved_at" = $12::timestamptz, "satisfaction_score" = $13::int, "description" = $14::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "subject", "customer_id", "requester_name", "status", "priority", "channel", "category", "assignee_id", "sla_due_at", "first_response_at", "resolved_at", "satisfaction_score", "description", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:tickets}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:tickets}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:tickets}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"

SELECT count(*)::int AS total,  count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'new')::int AS status_new, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'open')::int AS status_open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'pending')::int AS status_pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'resolved')::int AS status_resolved, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'closed')::int AS status_closed
FROM {{table:tickets}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS day, count(*)::int AS count
FROM {{table:tickets}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= coalesce(NULLIF($1::text, '')::date, now() - interval '90 days')
  AND created_at < (coalesce(NULLIF($2::text, '')::date, now()::date) + interval '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "status" AS status, count(*)::int AS count FROM {{table:tickets}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date) AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
